question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The solution is **by**.

• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1 "You will be quite surprised to know that the first telescope was made in the seventeenth century by Galileo." is 
 
• You will be quite surprised to know that the first telescope was made in the seventeenth century by Galileo.
 
• Preposition - A preposition is a word or phrase used to show the position of an object or someone.
 
 
• *For example: Through, at, in, onto, etc.*
 
 
 
• *​*A **preposition **is used with **its objects**.
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.
